description: This file defines the SchedulerClient class for the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the Amazon EventBridge Scheduler service. It includes method annotations for various scheduler operations and their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: SchedulerClient
classes.description: Client for interacting with AWS EventBridge Scheduler service, providing methods to create, delete, get, list, tag, untag, and update schedules and schedule groups.

methods.name: createSchedule
methods.description: Creates a new schedule in Amazon EventBridge Scheduler.

methods.name: createScheduleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new schedule in Amazon EventBridge Scheduler.

methods.name: createScheduleGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new schedule group.

methods.name: getSchedule
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific schedule.

methods.name: getScheduleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific schedule.

methods.name: getScheduleGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details of a schedule group.

methods.name: getScheduleGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a schedule group.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
